For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.

WITH daily_net AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        TRY_CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END as net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as running_balance,
        FIRST_VALUE(txn_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as first_txn_date
    FROM daily_net
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date, net_amount
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        running_balance,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date 
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as rolling_avg_30day,
        first_txn_date,
        DATEDIFF('day', first_txn_date, txn_date) as days_since_first
    FROM daily_balance
),
with_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        rolling_avg_30day,
        first_txn_date,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date) as txn_month,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date) as txn_year,
        CASE WHEN rolling_avg_30day < 0 THEN 0 ELSE rolling_avg_30day END as avg_30day
    FROM rolling_avg
    WHERE days_since_first >= 30
),
customer_first_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(first_txn_date AS DATE)) as first_month,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(first_txn_date AS DATE)) as first_year
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, TRY_CAST(FIRST_VALUE(txn_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS DATE) as first_txn_date
        FROM customer_transactions
    )
),
customer_month_avg_max AS (
    SELECT 
        w.customer_id,
        w.txn_month,
        w.txn_year,
        MAX(w.avg_30day) as max_30day_avg
    FROM with_month w
    JOIN customer_first_month c ON w.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE (w.txn_month != c.first_month OR w.txn_year != c.first_year)
    GROUP BY w.customer_id, w.txn_month, w.txn_year
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as unique_customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT txn_month * 100 + txn_year) as unique_months
FROM customer_month_avg_max
